issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Talanoa
products.tagline: Email that feels like chat
products.summaryZh: 像聊天一样的电子邮件
products.descriptionZh: Talanoa 是你的首个邮件即时通讯工具。它将杂乱的邮件线程整理成清爽的、类似聊天的对话，并在此过程中去除引用、签名和冗余内容。把邮件变成可执行的待办事项，无需离开收件箱即可管理日历，并使用私密的设备端 AI 进行搜索、总结和撰写。在一个统一收件箱中连接 Gmail、Outlook、iCloud 或任何 IMAP 账户。一切都保留在你的电脑上：无云同步、无追踪、无人读取你的邮件。
products.description: Talanoa is your first email messenger. It turns messy email threads into clean, chat-like conversations, removing quotes, signatures and clutter along the way. Turn emails into actionable todos, manage your calendar without leaving your inbox, and use private, on-device AI to search, summarize and write. Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud or any IMAP account in one unified inbox. Everything stays on your computer: no cloud sync, no tracking, no one reading your emails.

products.name: Navige
products.tagline: Cut AI agent costs and control runaway spending
products.summaryZh: 削减AI代理成本，控制失控支出
products.descriptionZh: Navige 利用充分性智能在任务运行中降低 AI 代理成本。它将合适的请求发送给更小的模型，缓存重复读取并精简庞大的工具结果。如果不确定，它会保留你选择的模型。设置预算、捕获失控循环并批准敏感操作。按任务查看成本和节省，估算值会明确标注。Watchtower 永久免费。在开启控制前预览更改。
products.description: Navige uses Sufficiency Intelligence to cut AI agent costs while work runs. It sends suitable requests to smaller models, caches repeated reads and trims bulky tool results. If unsure, it keeps your chosen model. Set budgets, catch runaway loops and approve sensitive actions. See costs and savings by job, with estimates clearly labelled. Watchtower is free forever. Preview changes before switching controls on.

products.name: GLM-Legal
products.tagline: Z.ai’s legal AI model for contract review and compliance
products.summaryZh: Z.ai 用于合同审查与合规的法律 AI 模型
products.descriptionZh: LM-Legal 是 Z.ai 的法律 AI 模型，基于 GLM-5.3-Flash 构建，针对合同审查、证据分析、合规研究等智能体法律工作进行了训练。Z.ai 先加入法律中期训练，再在数万个法律任务环境中进行强化学习。据 Vals AI 评测，它在 Harvey 法律智能体基准测试中通过 19.17% 的任务，而基础模型为 6.67%。API 访问为仅限申请的测试版。
products.description: LM-Legal is Z.ai’s legal AI model, built on GLM-5.3-Flash and trained for agentic legal work like contract review, evidence analysis, and compliance research. Z.ai added legal mid-training, then reinforcement learning across tens of thousands of legal task environments. It passes 19.17% of tasks on Harvey’s Legal Agent Benchmark per Vals AI, up from 6.67% for the base model. API access is application-only beta

products.name: OpenMuse
products.tagline: Opensource, self hostable personal assistant for any harness
products.summaryZh: 开源、可自托管的个人助手，适用于任何 harness
products.descriptionZh: OpenMuse 是一个开源、可自托管的个人代理，拥有自己的浏览器、终端、文件和持久化工作。提出目标，观察其执行，审查操作，然后回来查看结果。兼容任何代理框架。
products.description: OpenMuse is an open-source, self-hostable personal agent with its own browser, terminal, files, and persistent work. Ask for an outcome, watch it work, review actions, and come back to the result. Compatible with any agent harness.

products.name: Daddy Issues
products.tagline: Think ahead. Fight less. A weekly family briefing for dads.
products.summaryZh: 提前规划，减少争吵。为爸爸们准备的每周家庭简报。
products.descriptionZh: Daddy Issues 利用 AI 帮助爸爸们提前思考，避免家庭生活变成最后一刻的手忙脚乱。每周，它会将你的孩子、日历、责任和任务连接起来，呈现即将到来的事项、你可能遗漏的内容，以及值得现在处理的事情。更少被动应对，更少提醒，更少小争吵——更多“我已经在处理了”。
products.description: Daddy Issues uses AI to help dads think ahead before family life turns into last-minute stress. Each week, it connects your kids, calendar, responsibilities and tasks to surface what’s coming up, what you might be missing, and what’s worth handling now. Less reacting, fewer reminders, fewer small fights — and more “I’m already on it.”

products.name: Polylane Impact Analysis
products.tagline: Catch risky pull requests before they break production
products.summaryZh: 在破坏生产环境之前捕获有风险的拉取请求
products.descriptionZh: 在问题影响生产环境之前将其捕获。Polylane 会对照你的实时基础设施——包括其配置、容量、依赖项和遥测数据——审查每一个拉取请求。对于每个拉取请求，你都会得到一份分析，其中包含所有证据，告诉你该拉取请求是否可以安全地合并到生产环境。Polylane 还会在你的分支上提议缺失的埋点，并在部署后持续监控。
products.description: Catch issues before they break production. Polylane reviews every pull request against your live infrastructure: its config, capacity, dependencies and telemetry. For every pull request, you get a an analysis including all the evidence telling you if the pull request is safe to merge against production. Polylane also proposes missing instrumentation on your branch and keeps watching after deployment.

products.name: withHuman
products.tagline: A open-source human approval layer for AI Agents
products.summaryZh: 面向AI代理的开源人工审批层
products.descriptionZh: withHuman 是 AI 智能体的审批层。它在智能体调用工具执行前进行拦截。规则自动批准或拒绝常规调用，有风险的调用则转交给团队中相应的人员。它适用于 Claude Code、Codex 以及用 LangGraph、Pydantic AI 等构建的智能体，通过开放协议（AAP）实现。一套规则适用于公司运行的所有智能体。开源，并提供托管版本。使用优惠码 PRODUCTHUNT 可免费获得 3 个月 Scale 版——有效期至周五！
products.description: withHuman is an approval layer for AI agents. It intercepts your agents’ tool calls before they run. Rules approve or deny routine calls automatically, and risky ones go to the right person on your team. It works across Claude Code, Codex and agents built with LangGraph, Pydantic AI and more, through an open protocol (AAP). One set of rules for every agent your company runs. Open source, with a hosted version. Use code PRODUCTHUNT for 3 months of Scale free - valid till Friday!

products.name: Ubuntu 26.10 (Stonking Stingray)
products.tagline: GNOME 51, Rust coreutils, and a refreshed Linux desktop
products.summaryZh: GNOME 51、Rust coreutils，以及焕然一新的 Linux 桌面
products.descriptionZh: Ubuntu 26.10“Stonking Stingray”带来GNOME 51、扩展的硬件支持，并全面切换至基于Rust的coreutils。应用中心统一了Snap和Debian软件包的详细信息，并新增显卡驱动管理。可选的Myna预览版提供本地语音转文字功能。这是一个面向开发者和Linux爱好者的非LTS版本，适合希望在长期支持版本之间获取更新软件的用户。
products.description: Ubuntu 26.10 "Stonking Stingray" brings GNOME 51, expanded hardware support, and a complete switch to Rust-based coreutils. App Center unifies Snap and Debian package details and adds graphics driver management. An optional Myna preview offers local speech-to-text. A non-LTS release for developers and Linux enthusiasts who want newer software between long-term releases.

products.name: siliXon
products.tagline: Turn a plain English idea into a circuit board you can order
products.summaryZh: 把简单的英语创意变成可订购的电路板
products.descriptionZh: 用平实的英语描述你的设备，siliXon 就能一路做到可布线、可制造的 PCB，为任何有想法的人而设计，而不只是工程师。只需几分钟。我们的设计代理 Rocky 会询问它需要了解的信息，然后挑选真实、可购买的元件，放置它们，绘制原理图并布线铜箔。可在 2D 和 3D 中编辑，或直接询问 Rocky。每块板在进入制造前都必须通过工程检查，设计文件归你所有。
products.description: Describe your device in plain English and siliXon takes it all the way to a routed, manufacturable PCB, built for anyone with an idea, not only engineers. In minutes. Rocky, our design agent, asks what it needs to know, then picks real, purchasable components, places them, draws the schematic and routes the copper. Edit in 2D and 3D, or just ask Rocky. Every board must pass engineering checks before it goes to manufacture, and the design files are yours.

products.name: Backdrop
products.tagline: Build AI coworkers for any workflow, any industry
products.summaryZh: 为任何工作流程、任何行业构建AI同事
products.descriptionZh: 为任何工作流程创建AI同事。赋予他们合适的工具和上下文访问权限，让他们研究、创作、协调、跟进并完成工作。将他们连接到Slack、Asana、Google、Hubspot、Meta、TikTok以及1500多个其他应用。
products.description: Create AI coworkers for any workflow. Give them access to the right tools and context, and let them research, create, coordinate, follow up, and get work done. Connect them to Slack, Asana, Google, Hubspot, Meta, TikTok, and 1500+ more apps.

products.name: Kerno 1.0
products.tagline: The AI Runtime Backend QA Engineer
products.summaryZh: AI运行时后端质量保证工程师
products.descriptionZh: Kerno v1 是我们迄今为止最大的一次升级，一个完整的 AI 后端 QA 工程师。它映射你的代码库，学习你的应用如何运作，并在每次运行中变得更加敏锐。现在它能测试你的整个后端，从完整的用户流程、实时安全检查，到后台任务、队列、MCP 服务器和 AWS 无服务器。Bug 会在你打开 PR 之前就在你的 agent 会话中被捕获，然后在 CI 中的每个 PR 上重新检查。
products.description: Kerno v1 is our biggest upgrade yet, a complete AI Backend QA Engineer. It maps your codebase, learns how your app works, and gets sharper with every run. It now tests your whole backend, from full user flows and live security checks to background jobs, queues, MCP servers and AWS serverless. Bugs get caught inside your agent's session before you open a PR, then re-checked on every PR in CI.

products.name: Reelbird
products.tagline: Open Source Loom + Screen Studio alternative for Mac
products.summaryZh: Mac 上的开源 Loom + Screen Studio 替代品
products.descriptionZh: Reelbird 是一款免费、开源的 Mac 屏幕录制工具。停止录制时，分享链接会自动复制到剪贴板。之后可添加自动缩放、平滑光标和字幕，再更新同一链接。原生 Swift 开发，无需账号，可使用你自己的 S3/R2 存储桶。已签名并公证。
products.description: Reelbird is a free, open-source Mac screen recorder. The share link is on your clipboard when you stop. Later, add auto-zoom, a smooth cursor and captions, then update the same link. Native Swift, no account, your own S3/R2 bucket. Signed and notarized.

products.name: AI Sandboxes by Buddy
products.tagline: Isolated cloud machines for your AI coding agents
products.summaryZh: 为你的AI编程代理提供隔离的云机器
products.descriptionZh: Buddy 沙盒为 AI 编码代理提供独立的 Linux 机器，用于构建、运行、测试和修复应用，而不会触及你的本地环境。每个沙盒都有持久磁盘、root 访问权限、Docker、SSH 和公共 URL。可按任务、分支或 PR 创建，然后让代理通过 MCP、CLI、SDK 或 API 进行管理。
products.description: Buddy Sandboxes give AI coding agents their own isolated Linux machines to build, run, test, and fix apps without touching your local setup. Each Sandbox has a persistent disk, root access, Docker, SSH, and a public URL. Create one per task, branch, or PR, then let your agents manage it through MCP, CLI, SDK, or API.

products.name: Actually Asked
products.tagline: A self-improving branded AI FAQ page
products.summaryZh: 一个自我完善的品牌AI常见问题页面
products.descriptionZh: Actually Asked 会在你的网站上添加一个 FAQ 区域，采用你的字体和颜色，而不是聊天窗口。访客可以提出自己的问题，或高亮一句话来询问。答案仅来自你的页面，提问最多的问题会加入你的 FAQ。
products.description: Actually Asked puts a FAQ section on your site, in your fonts and colours, not a chat bubble. Visitors ask their own question or highlight a sentence to ask about it. Answers come only from your pages, and the questions asked most join your FAQ.

products.name: SuperLocalMemory
products.tagline: Agent memory with Laya, Jev + Google Gemma
products.summaryZh: Laya、Jev 与 Google Gemma 的智能体记忆
products.descriptionZh: SuperLocalMemory 重新发布，从底层彻底重建，背后有四篇 arXiv 论文支撑。一个本地优先的记忆大脑，适用于 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、ChatGPT 以及任何 MCP 或 CLI 智能体。它从不含糊其辞：回忆结果会明确标注为支持、相关或无答案，由你 Mac 上的 Laya 或线上的 Jev 进行核查。通过描述即可查找图片和 PDF，依托 Google 的 EmbeddingGemma 2。受治理、网状互联、AGPL-3.0。由 Qualixar 打造，这家 AI 可靠性工程实验室已推出 10 款开源产品。
products.description: The relaunch of SuperLocalMemory, rebuilt from the ground up and backed by four arXiv papers. One local-first memory brain for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT and any MCP or CLI agent. It never bluffs: recall says supported, related or no answer, checked by Laya on your Mac or Jev online. Find pictures and PDFs by describing them, with Google’s EmbeddingGemma 2. Governed, mesh-connected, AGPL-3.0. Built by Qualixar, the AI Reliability Engineering lab behind 10 open-source products.

products.name: Afterparty
products.tagline: Automated actions for meeting deliverables
products.summaryZh: 为交付成果自动执行操作
products.descriptionZh: 记录工具给你一份清单，Afterparty 负责落实。粘贴文字记录或连接你的记录工具，智能代理便会在正确的应用中起草每一封邮件、消息、邀请和 CRM 记录，并结合你工具中的上下文。未经你批准，任何内容都不会发出。
products.description: Note takers give you a list. Afterparty does the list. Paste a transcript or connect your note taker, and agents draft every email, message, invite and CRM note in the right app, with context from your tools. Nothing goes out until you approve it.

products.name: Apple HomeView
products.tagline: A new way to stay connected, and manage the home
products.summaryZh: 连接与家庭管理的新方式
products.descriptionZh: Apple HomeView 是一款智能显示屏，配备 Siri AI、Liquid Retina 显示屏、高保真音频、FaceTime、智能家居控制、内置隐私保护等功能。
products.description: Apple HomeView is a smart display with Siri AI, Liquid Retina display, high-fidelity audio, FaceTime, smart home controls, built-in privacy, and more.

products.name: Chatway MCP
products.tagline: Let ChatGPT & Claude answer customer support tickets via MCP
products.summaryZh: 让 ChatGPT 和 Claude 通过 MCP 回复客户支持工单
products.descriptionZh: Chatway 是一个实时聊天和客户支持平台，支持接入你自己的 AI 代理。连接 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Cursor 或任何兼容 MCP 的助手，即可管理客户对话、回复消息、搜索联系人并访问你的知识库。无需编写代码。Chatway 还内置 AI 支持代理、共享收件箱、帮助中心、自动化、iOS 和 Android 应用，并与 WhatsApp、Instagram、Facebook Messenger 等集成。免费开始使用。
products.description: Chatway is a live chat and customer support platform that lets you bring your own AI agent. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible assistant to manage customer conversations, reply to messages, search contacts, and access your knowledge base. No coding required. Chatway also includes a built-in AI Support Agent, shared inbox, help center, automation, iOS and Android apps, and integrations with WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, and more. Get started for free.

products.name: Nostaliga
products.tagline: Rediscover the days behind your favorite songs
products.summaryZh: 重温你喜爱的歌曲背后的岁月
products.descriptionZh: Nostaliga 将你的收听历史变成个人时间线。任选一首歌，即可查看它前后那一天：你的照片、地点、跑步、签到、演出和帖子。还有跨越多年的“那年今日”。无需账户，不做追踪；你的时间线只保存在你的设备上。
products.description: Nostaliga turns your listening history into a personal timeline. Pick any song and see the day around it: your photos, places, runs, check-ins, shows and posts. Plus On This Day across the years. No account, no tracking; your timeline lives on your device.

products.name: Fwrd
products.tagline: Forward iPhone texts to Slack, Discord, or Telegram
products.summaryZh: 将 iPhone 短信转发至 Slack、Discord 或 Telegram
products.descriptionZh: Fwrd 通过你在 Apple Shortcuts 中创建的信息自动化，将符合条件的 iPhone 短信转发到 Slack、Discord 或 Telegram。该自动化在你的 iPhone 上运行，并发送到你控制的目标。无需 Fwrd 账户。每个日历月可免费转发 15 条。设置指南：https://www.fwrdsms.com/guides/automation
products.description: Fwrd routes qualifying iPhone texts to Slack, Discord, or Telegram through a Message automation you create in Apple Shortcuts. The automation runs from your iPhone and sends to destinations you control. No Fwrd account is required. Start with 15 forwards per calendar month free. Setup guide: https://www.fwrdsms.com/guides/automation
